# UC-370 — Block Demotion of the Last Store Owner

## Header Info
- **Use Case ID:** UC-370
- **Title:** Block Demotion of the Last Store Owner
- **Actor:** Vendor (ACT-02) — Owner of the own store
- **Trigger:** The Owner tries to demote or remove the only remaining Owner of the store
- **Priority:** P1
- **Goal:** Keep at least one Owner on every store roster so the store is never left without its privileged role.
- **Preconditions:** Caller is the store Owner; roster read succeeds (API-VND-016); `ownerUserId` is known for the store.

## Main Scenario
1. Owner opens the staff roster → client `GET /store/staff` lists members, roles and `ownerUserId` (API-VND-016).
2. Owner attempts to demote the sole Owner → client `PATCH /store/staff/{userId}/role` with a Viewer/Editor/Manager role (API-VND-018).
3. Server counts active Owners of this store; the target is the last one → the request is refused with `FORBIDDEN` by a last-owner guard shaped like `LAST_SUPER_ADMIN`.
4. Nothing is written: role, roster and sessions are unchanged.
5. Owner promotes another member to Owner first → with two Owners present the demotion is then accepted (API-VND-018).

## Alternative Scenarios
- **A1 — Demote a non-last Owner:** allowed → 200 with the new role, a reason recorded and an audit entry written (BR-PLT-06).
- **A2 — Self-escalation attempt:** a staff member changing their own role → 403 `STAFF_SELF_ESCALATION`, never applied (BR-VND-06).
- **A3 — Remove instead of demote:** `DELETE /store/staff/{userId}` on the last Owner hits the same guard → `FORBIDDEN` (API-VND-019).

## Exception Scenarios
- **E1 — Role outside the staff set:** target role not in Viewer/Editor/Manager → 403 `INVALID_ROLE`; roster unchanged (BR-VND-06).
- **E2 — Non-owner caller:** an Editor or Manager attempts a role change → 403 `FORBIDDEN`; only the Owner changes staff roles (BR-VND-06).
- **E3 — Unknown user or foreign store:** → 404 `NOT_FOUND`; the guard never runs (BR-VND-07).

## Postconditions
- Refused: roster and roles unchanged; the store always retains ≥1 Owner.
- Accepted: new role stored with reason and an append-only audit entry (BR-PLT-06).

## Business Rules Applied
- BR-VND-06, BR-VND-07, BR-PLT-06

## Related Requirements
- FR-002 (Roles, Permissions & Access Control)

## Permissions / Data / External Dependencies
- **Permissions:** Owner only; staff cannot change their own role (conceptual test 3, DOC-OVR-007) — server-side (SEC-REQ-004).
- **Data involved:** store staff roster rows (role, ownerUserId), audit log.
- **External dependencies:** audit log store (B13); session revocation applies only on member removal (API-VND-019).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC-UC370-01:** Given a store with one Owner, when that Owner is demoted, then `FORBIDDEN` is returned and the roster is unchanged (BR-VND-06).
- **AC-UC370-02:** Given two Owners, when one is demoted, then the change succeeds with an audit entry (BR-PLT-06).
- **AC-UC370-03:** Given a staff member changing their own role, when attempted, then `STAFF_SELF_ESCALATION` is returned (BR-VND-06).
- **AC-UC370-04:** Given a non-owner staff caller, when a demotion is attempted, then `FORBIDDEN` is returned (BR-VND-06).
